name: 鼠标与键盘操作 (Mouse & Keyboard)
description: 提供平滑拟人化鼠标移动、点击、拖拽滑动、滚轮滚动、键盘输入打字、快捷键触发与按键监听功能

CellsClick.description: Automatically perform mouse clicks in specified grid or cell area

Click.description: Click or double click mouse at current position or specified coordinates

ClickAt.description: Move mouse cursor to absolute screen coordinates and perform click(s) with instant or smooth motion

ClickWindowRelative.description: Click relative to target window or its client area, immune to window movement and DPI scaling

ConnectKmbox.description: Connect KMBox (B+ Serial / Net UDP) or Makcu (ESP32-S3 Serial) hardware box to bypass anti-cheat and route mouse/keyboard actions

DragPointer.description: Hold mouse button and smoothly drag from current position to target offset

GetKeyState.description: Check toggle lock status (CapsLock/NumLock) or physical pressed state (Ctrl/Shift/Alt/etc.)

HoldKey.description: Unified key state control supporting tap-and-hold (Hold), holding down (Down), or releasing (Up)

ListenKeyboard.description: Listen for keyboard events in background or register global shortcuts

ListenMouse.description: Listen for mouse click or move events in background with optional event blocking

MovePointer.description: Move mouse cursor to absolute screen coordinates or relative offset

PointerPosition.description: Get current cursor screen coordinates or teleport cursor to specified position

SendKey.description: Send shortcut key combination to current active window

SendText.description: Type a string of text into current input field

WaitKey.description: Pause workflow until user presses a specified key or timeout occurs

WheelMouse.description: Simulate mouse wheel scrolling up or down by specified steps
